html_source: Ian Gunn's map of Bloom's walk, with numbers locating Lemon and Co. (1), the Ballast Office (2), Harrison and Co. (3), the Irish Times (4), the College Street police station (5), the College Hotel and M'Caughey Restaurant (6), the statue of Thomas Moore (7), Walter Sexton's shop (8), and the Provost's House (9), and added dots indicating Butler's on Bachelor's Walk (blue), Fleet Street (orange), and the TCD main gate (red). Source: Gunn and Hart, James Joyce's Dublin.
